butterbot.gui.api_help_text:
bot.say(text)  bot.pos() -> x,y,z
bot.goTo(x,y,z) -> ok  bot.dig(x,y,z) -> ok
bot.place(x,y,z,"item") -> ok  bot.block(x,y,z) -> id
bot.scan("name", radius) -> x,y,z
bot.deliver()  bot.deposit()  bot.home()
bot.count("item")  bot.inventoryCount()
bot.ownerPos() -> x,y,z
bot.sleep(seconds)  print(...)

butterbot.gui.find_tooltip: Tells you where the nearest block of this resource is, up to %s blocks from you in the loaded area (also through walls).
butterbot.gui.farm_help: Harvests and replants ripe crops, berries, cocoa, sugar cane, melons and pumpkins, fells grown trees and plants their saplings, and sows seeds on empty farmland. Works within %s blocks of the Bot Base (or of the bot) until you say stop.

butterbot.gui.guard_tooltip: Fights monsters near the bot or you. Never hits players, animals or pets, and leaves endermen and piglins alone until they attack.
butterbot.gui.torches_auto_tooltip: Places a torch whenever it gets dark underground while mining.
butterbot.gui.feed_tooltip: Feeds you food from its backpack when you are hungry (never rotten flesh, golden apples or stews).

butterbot.gui.perk_vein: Mines whole ore veins (up to %s blocks)
butterbot.gui.level_hint: Bots level up by working and fighting.

butterbot.gui.light_tooltip: Places torches on every dark spot within %s blocks of you so no monsters spawn there. Uses torches from the backpack first.

key.butterbot.light: Light up the area around me

butterbot.gui.default_skin_tooltip: Switches to the next of the %s built-in neko skins (a custom skin is taken off). New bots automatically get a skin none of your other bots wear.

butterbot.job.none.tooltip: No job: the bot follows your orders and stays where it is between them.
butterbot.job.miner.tooltip: Digs ores and stone far from your base until everything on its list is in its chest. Never digs inside the no-dig zone around the base.
butterbot.job.gatherer.tooltip: Collects wood, sand, sugar cane, pumpkins and other surface things far from your base until everything on its list is in its chest.
butterbot.job.guard.tooltip: Patrols around a spot you pick, fights every monster there, picks up the loot and puts it in a chest in the area.
butterbot.job.farmer.tooltip: Harvests and replants the fields around a spot you pick, all the time, and puts the harvest in a chest.

butterbot.job.bodyguard.tooltip: Follows one of your other bots everywhere (through portals too) and fights the monsters around it.

butterbot.gui.job_none_help:
Give this bot a job and it keeps doing it whenever you don't need it.

Miner and Gatherer fill one chest with the items on their list, never digging near your base. Guard patrols an area and stores the loot. Farmer keeps a field going. Rancher looks after animals. Courier carries chests' contents to another chest. Bodyguard protects another bot.
butterbot.gui.job_guard_info: Monsters defeated: %s. Patrols %s blocks around the spot and puts the loot in the chest.
butterbot.gui.job_farmer_info: Harvested: %s. Farms %s blocks around the spot; the harvest goes in the chest (or the Bot Base).

butterbot.ui.home_none_tip: This bot has no Bot Base yet. Place one, or open the panel from a Bot Base.
butterbot.ui.deliver_tip: Brings everything in its backpack to you (or to the base) right now.

butterbot.ui.light_tip: Puts torches on every dark spot within %s blocks of you so no monsters spawn.

butterbot.ui.sort_tip: Stacks and groups the chests and barrels within %s blocks of the Bot Base.
